narrative_purpose: Sets the lattice template beside the Na'vi so every reduction lines up at a glance - six limbs to four, four eyes to two, paired queues to one, opercula to a nose - showing the Na'vi as the template edited, not redesigned.
subject: A side-by-side comparison plate. On the left, a generic six-limbed Pandoran hexapod in profile: six limbs, four eyes, a pair of temple queues, and lateral breathing slits along the flank, all clearly present. On the right, an upright Na'vi figure in matching profile: four limbs, two eyes, a single queue at the back of the head, breathing through cranial nostrils - with the lost features (the middle limb pair, the second eye pair, the second queue, the flank slits) shown as faint dimmed ghost-marks where they would have been.
scene: A dark comparative-anatomy space, the two figures floating as paired specimens, a soft vertical divide of haze between them.
camera: A flat front-facing comparison view, both figures the same height in frame, matched poses for easy reading.
light: Bioluminescent key from within both figures, cyan and teal; the hexapod's full feature set glowing brightly, the Na'vi's lost features barely glimmering as ghost-marks; deep indigo divide.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cyan and living-teal glow on present features, dim grey-teal ghosting on the lost features, one scarce amber accent.
style: Painterly comparative-anatomy plate, hand-painted texture, balanced two-figure clarity.
detail_level: Crisp on both figures' limb counts, eyes, queues, and breathing structures; the ghost-marks deliberately faint; background minimal dark haze.
composition: Two profile figures filling left and right halves, matched in scale and pose, a soft central vertical divide, dark margins.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, bioluminescent key. The reductions must read clearly through brightness contrast, not text. Same mood as the chapter cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no infographic chrome, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
